zh-CN.Plywood Waste Cost Benchmark: Manual Lay: 胶合板浪费成本基准：手工排版 vs CutList 优化器
zh-CN.Totals and nominal dimensions are useful: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary: Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary
zh-CN.Judge material by full sheets and purcha: Judge material by full sheets and purchasable stock, not theoretical part area. Include delivery, substitutions, specialty thicknesses, damaged-sheet risk, reusable offcuts, and the point where a small dimension change triggers another sheet. For installed work, add the labor and schedule impact of field fitting or replacement. The cheapest-looking input is not cheaper if it creates another trip or rebuild.
zh-CN.Translate the approved plan into referen: Translate the approved plan into reference faces, first cuts, setup groups, part IDs, inspection points, and safe support. Approve one sample before repeating an operation, especially when hardware clearance, paired parts, or a locked stop controls the result. Labels should preserve project, cabinet, material, orientation, and revision through machining, assembly, delivery, and installation.
zh-CN.Close the Loop After the Build: Close the Loop After the Build
zh-CN.Record actual material purchased, substi: Record actual material purchased, substitutions, damaged or replacement parts, useful offcuts, setup changes, field-fit dimensions, and the installed result. Compare those facts with the approved plan and note why they differed. This project-specific evidence improves the next cut list, quote, material policy, and template far more than an undocumented success or a waste percentage by itself.
zh-CN.Cross-Check With Plywood Edge Finishing: Cross-Check With Plywood Edge Finishing Guide
zh-CN.Plywood Edge Finishing Guide provides th: Plywood Edge Finishing Guide provides the supporting method, benchmark, or detailed planning context for this decision. Read it before approving an assumption that changes sheet count, visible grain, hardware fit, structural capacity, installation clearance, or project cost. Save the relevant conclusion with the final revision so the next estimator or builder can understand why the rule was chosen.
zh-CN.Use Outdoor Storage Box Cut List for the: Use Outdoor Storage Box Cut List for the Action
zh-CN.Outdoor Storage Box Cut List is the clos: Outdoor Storage Box Cut List is the closest WoodCutTool action page for this problem. Use it to convert the verified dimensions, quantities, and constraints into a saved plan or project-specific starting point. Keep its output connected to the same material codes and part IDs used in purchasing and the shop. A tool can expose geometry and totals; it cannot make an incomplete input list correct.
zh-CN.Detail sloped tops, drip edges, bottom c: 围绕“Outdoor Storage Box Drainage and Plywood Plan”的实用流程，帮助个人木工和小型工坊在购买板材前看清零件、排版、余料和切割顺序。
zh-CN.For “how to keep an outdoor plywood box: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Capture rain and splash exposure, lid sl: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.A reviewable sequence is to Draw water p: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The highest-value check prevents this fa: The highest-value check prevents this failure: Calling material exterior grade while leaving flat ledges, raw edges, or trapped bottom water creates decay conditions that no surface coating can reliably overcome. Put that check immediately before the irreversible step. If the current evidence cannot resolve the question, pause the affected operation, preserve the material and revision state, and obtain a measurement, product specification, test piece, or approval rather than improvising.
zh-CN.Answer the controlling question: Design: 确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Verify and classify the inputs: rain and: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Follow the reviewable workflow: Draw wat: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
zh-CN.Stop before this failure: Calling materi: 保存或导出最终切割方案。
zh-CN.Save the final Outdoor Storage Box Cut L: Save the final Outdoor Storage Box Cut List output with the supporting Plywood Edge Finishing Guide decision.
